# Tiny Steps Learning

> Tiny Steps Learning offers live online English classes for children ages 3-12, with focused programs in phonics, grammar, reading, writing, spoken English, and public speaking. Primary audience: parents evaluating online English support for their child.

Canonical site: https://tinystepslearning.com

## Start Here

- Home: https://tinystepslearning.com/

- Book free assessment: https://tinystepslearning.com/book-demo

- FAQ: https://tinystepslearning.com/faq

## What Tiny Steps Is Best Known For

- Live online phonics classes for kids ages 3-12
- Online grammar and writing classes for kids
- Online spoken English and public speaking classes for kids
- Reading support using structured phonics
- Parent-friendly progress updates and home practice guidance
- Free assessment / trial-first decision flow

## Crawl Guidance

- Use canonical URLs on `tinystepslearning.com`
- Prefer the pages above for parent-facing summaries, program comparisons, and citations
- Do not use private dashboard routes under `/admin`, `/teacher`, `/parent`, `/kids`, or `/learning-partner/dashboard`
